# Tests left out of the runs on the haze backend, one `PATTERN | REASON` per line (gtest patterns,
# several joined with `:`). A test belongs here when it has no meaning on this backend, or when
# the backend lacks the feature it tests; the reason says which, and a missing feature says so
# ("Not implemented on haze"). It is counted as not applicable in the test report, with this
# reason, and it is not run.
#
# A pattern that matches no test is an error (see .github/scripts/run_gtest.py).

DropInputHost.DecryptSurvivesDroppedInputCuda | Tests the CUDA backend's device ciphertexts
ReducedNoise.SerializeDeserializeCudaReducedNoiseRoundTrip | Serializes a CUDA context, which needs a build with the CUDA backend
CKKSTest.ConcurrentHostShadowCopyOnWrite | Needs the concurrent-operations mode of the CUDA backend (FIDESLIB_CONCURRENT_OPS=1)
Techniques/ApiParityTechniqueTest.OperandAdjustment/FIXEDMANUAL | FIXEDMANUAL does not adjust operands: a degree or level mismatch is the caller's to resolve
Shapes/ApiParityBootstrapShapeTest.EvalBootstrap/*FIXEDMANUAL:LevelBudgets/ApiParityFullPackBootstrapTest.EvalBootstrapFullyPacked/*FIXEDMANUAL | Not implemented on haze: the bootstrap does not support FIXEDMANUAL
Shapes/ApiParityBootstrapShapeTest.EvalBootstrap/SparseEncapsulated_* | Not implemented on haze: the bootstrap does not support SPARSE_ENCAPSULATED secrets (its output does not decrypt)
LevelBudgets/ApiParityFullPackBootstrapTest.EvalBootstrapFullyPacked/*FLEXIBLEAUTO*:LevelBudgets/ApiParityFullPackBootstrapTest.EvalBootstrapFullyPacked/*FLEXIBLEAUTOEXT | The in-process simulator cannot hold a fully packed FLEXIBLE bootstrap at the ring size its replay bridge accepts for FLEXIBLE scaling primes (2^16)
